phases.name: The Doors Open
phases.say: (Every door in the hall opens at once. There is someone standing in each of them.)

phases.name: No Face At All
phases.say: (It bends down until its blank face is level with yours. It has been smiling the whole time. You can tell.)

say.open: (At the end of a corridor that was not there yesterday, something stoops under the ceiling. It has been waiting for you to look up.)
say.death: (It folds down into the floorboards like a coat dropped on a chair. The hall is shorter now.)

bestiary.lore: Children in the Faceless City are told never to walk the long hall alone. The ones who did are the ones in the doorways.
bestiary.weakness: Holy. It cannot be frightened or blinded; protect the Scions with the least Sanity, it goes for them.
bestiary.pattern: Stares at the whole party every fourth turn (Fear, Sanity), drags a Back Scion forward with its long arms, and embraces the most shaken. At 60% the doors open and two more faceless join; its footsteps shake three rows. At 30% it shows you its face every other turn (Madness, heavy Sanity).
